messages:
eva_dev: Heads-up: hit a reproducible duplicate-write when using AsyncClient inside asyncio.wait_for. Short snippet below.

eva_dev: snippet:
```py
import asyncio
from redwood import AsyncClient

async def run():
    async with AsyncClient(api_key="sk_test") as c:
        await c.create_record(data={"x": 1})

asyncio.run(asyncio.wait_for(run(), timeout=2))
```

eva_dev: Observed: outer wait_for raises TimeoutError, but server actually received and processed the request. SDK retried once after its transport timeout and created a duplicate record.

frank_infra: can you grab SDK debug logs and request ids? Does this occur with client.set_timeout(...) as well?

eva_dev: Logs (redacted):
```
2026-03-01T09:00:00.100Z DEBUG send id=rid1 POST /v1/records
2026-03-01T09:00:01.900Z WARN transport timeout id=rid1
2026-03-01T09:00:01.901Z ERROR context exit while inflight id=rid1
2026-03-01T09:00:02.050Z INFO retrying id=rid1 -> rid1-r1
2026-03-01T09:00:02.200Z INFO success id=rid1-r1
```

gina_oncall: we've seen this pattern: when outer task cancels the coroutine, the low-level socket write can still complete later. SDK currently treats transport timeouts as retriable and replays immediately.

frank_infra: Proposed fix: introduce an UncertainSendError on transport timeouts/cancellations and change retry policy to only auto-retry when request is idempotent or the error is a clear transient network failure. Also make __aexit__ wait for inflight send/cancellation to settle.

eva_dev: filed issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/4991 with repro. I'll draft a tiny PR that: (1) adds UncertainSendError, (2) updates retry policy to skip auto-retry when uncertain unless idempotency key is present, (3) makes context manager await internal send tasks during close.

gina_oncall: Add tests: fake server that ACKs after delay; unit tests for asyncio.wait_for; integration test to confirm no duplicate writes without idempotency.

frank_infra: Short-term guidance for customers: use idempotency keys for mutating endpoints and avoid aggressive outer timeouts around SDK calls. Also document this behavior in migration notes.

devex-bot: Issue #4991 created by eva_dev: "async wait_for + transport timeout -> potential replay of POSTs". Labels: bug, sdk-python, needs-pr.

eva_dev: Will post PR link here once ready. Thanks for the quick triage.
